# sdwan_transport_wan_vpn_interface_dsl_ipoe_feature (Resource)

This resource can manage a Transport WAN VPN Interface DSL IPoE Feature.
  - Minimum SD-WAN Manager version: `20.15.0`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sdwan_transport_wan_vpn_interface_dsl_ipoe_feature" "example" {
  name                         = "Example"
  description                  = "My Example"
  feature_profile_id           = "f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
  transport_wan_vpn_feature_id = "140331f6-5418-4755-a059-13c77eb96037"
  shutdown                     = true
  vdsl_slot                    = "0/0/0"
  interface_name               = "GigabitEthernet1"
  ipv4_address_type            = "dynamic"
  ipv4_address                 = "192.0.2.10"
  ipv4_subnet_mask             = "255.255.255.0"
  tunnel_interface_enabled     = true
  tunnel_interface_color       = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Expected import identifier with the format: "transport_wan_vpn_interface_dsl_ipoe_feature_id,feature_profile_id,transport_wan_vpn_feature_id"
terraform import sdwan_transport_wan_vpn_interface_dsl_ipoe_feature.example "f6b2c44c-693c-4763-b010-895aa3d236bd,f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac,140331f6-5418-4755-a059-13c77eb96037"
```
